calculation.description: For each tradable asset, negate its completed five-session return; strengthen the reversal when the lagged five-session VIX change is positive and downscale it otherwise. VIX is observation-only and is never traded.

validation.regime_notes: Daily IC was positive in every calendar year: 2020 0.0566, 2021 0.0504, 2022 0.1185, 2023 0.0265, 2024 0.0823, 2025 0.0123, and 2026 0.0412. Predictive strength is concentrated at the next-day horizon; coverage is limited because the VIX conditioning branch only supplies valid signals on approximately half of dates. Conservative interpretation is warranted for the 15-asset universe.
